about: PIECE SPEC for the WYGWYL cut-out cast. Lengths measured from the Bolas skeleton; widths authored. One axis rule for every piece.
axis_rule: every card: joint A at the pivot, joint B straight down; place at atan2(B-A) - 90. No exceptions — the boot was the exception and it is upside down in 389 of 520 frames of T102.
